changelog: New/Edit Strategy modal redesign: the old 'Applies to all challenges' checkbox + a tiny scrolling checkbox list (floating checkboxes, small grey all-caps labels wrapping onto two lines) is replaced with a toggle switch ('All challenges', on by default for a new strategy) and a grid of selectable challenge tiles -- the whole tile is the click target, with a check mark, tinted background and accent border when selected.
Turning 'All challenges' off no longer loses your tile picks if you turn it back on -- the previous selection is restored exactly.
A 'Used on: ...' summary line and a plain-words reason next to a disabled Save button replace the old silent failure mode where saving with nothing selected could create a strategy nobody can see.

Edit mode now warns before saving if re-scoping away from a challenge will clear that challenge's Pre-Trade Checklist default (names the specific challenge(s), only shown when it will actually happen).

No inner scroll box any more -- the picker grows with its content; only the modal body scrolls on a short viewport, and Save/Cancel stay visible (sticky footer). Works down to 360px, keyboard-operable (space/enter toggles a tile, visible focus ring, role/aria-checked set correctly), respects prefers-reduced-motion.
Strategy Lab list cards now show the same 'Used on: ...' wording and small chips as the modal's own summary, so the two views agree.

UI only -- no API/endpoint contract change, no migration. The 'all challenges' default for a new strategy was already correct in the v3.29.0 code (openStrategyModal() with no args already set it true); if live showed it unchecked, that was a stale/un-updated deploy, not a code bug -- confirmed by reading the shipped v3.29.0 JS directly.
release_notes: Pure front-end redesign of the New/Edit Strategy modal (app/modals/strategy-builder-modal.php, app/js/strategies.js, app/css/style.css) -- no controller changes, no new/changed API action, no migration, no change to any existing strategy's assignment. Verified with a new standalone Playwright driver, tools/ui-harness/drive-v3291.mjs, which builds its fixture straight from the real current source files on disk (plus `git show HEAD:...` for the 'before' comparison) so it can't go stale: 26/26 assertions covering the default-on toggle, dimmed/disabled tiles while All is on, Save disabled with the reason shown in words (missing name, then no challenge selected), the 2-tile summary line, the All-off/on/off round trip restoring the exact previous selection, keyboard Space/Enter on a tile (including a regression check that a second toggle still works after the first -- a full-grid re-render was found during development to silently drop focus, fixed by mutating only the affected tile's own DOM node), keyboard Enter on the toggle switch, edit-mode pre-fill, the cleared-default notice (shown only when a default will actually be cleared, hidden otherwise), the zero-challenges empty state, the 360px single-column grid with no independent scrollbar on the tile grid itself, and the sticky footer staying inside a short viewport. php -l and node --check pass clean on every changed file; duplicate-name scan clean; full tools/ui-harness suite (13 pre-existing drivers + this new one) passes -- one driver (drive-v3240.mjs) hit a transient 15s network-wait timeout when all 13 ran back-to-back under shared-port resource contention, re-ran standalone immediately after and passed clean; not touched by this release (no backtest files changed).
